title: Turbosmart Boost Gauge 30psi 52mm
description:
OverviewKeep accurate, real-time tabs on your turbocharger or supercharger setup with the Turbosmart 52mm Mechanical Boost Gauge. Designed for ultimate reliability and zero signal lag, this mechanical gauge reads manifold vacuum and positive pressure up to 30 PSI.

Housed in a standard 52mm (2-1/16") body, it drops seamlessly into most universal gauge pods, pillar mounts, and dash bezels. Its high-contrast black face dial and crisp illumination ensure clear readability at a glance in both direct sunlight and night driving conditions.

Key Features• Zero-Lag Mechanical Movement: Direct pneumatic sensing provides instant, reliable boost and vacuum readings.• Standard 52mm (2-1/16") Fitment: Fits all standard aftermarket gauge pods, pillar mounts, and dash plates.• 0 to 30 PSI Range: Ideal for street, track, and high-performance forced induction builds.• High-Contrast Display: Clean white numbering on a black background with clear backlighting for optimal night visibility.• Complete Installation Kit: Comes supplied with brass fittings, nylon pressure tubing, and mounting hardware.

Product Specifications• Part Number: TS-0101-2023• Brand: Turbosmart• Gauge Size: 52mm (2-1/16 in)• Pressure Range: 0 – 30 PSI• Type: Mechanical• Color / Finish: Black Face Dial / Silver Bezel
